title: One Point Lesson - Bearing Oil Bath Level & Greasing (OPL-GA-1201A-02)
content:
ONE POINT LESSON (OPL): OPL-GA-1201A-02 - Bearing Oil Bath Level & Greasing.

Equipment: GA-1201A (HEXANE FEED PUMP), Discipline: Mechanical, Area: 1200 – HEXANE FEED SYSTEM.

Related Interlock: SEQ-1201 (SIL 1), P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-1201.

PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE:
Bearing oil bath level & greasing for GA-1201A (HEXANE FEED PUMP) in the HEXANE FEED SYSTEM

SAFETY PRECAUTIONS:
- Precaution 1: Apply LOTO (Lock-Out Tag-Out) and prove zero energy before starting work.
- Precaution 2: Isolate, depressurise, drain and purge the equipment; obtain a valid work permit.
- Precaution 3: Wear the correct PPE: coverall, safety shoes, gloves, goggles and hearing protection.
- Precaution 4: Beware of stored mechanical energy (springs, rotating inertia) and pinch points.
- Precaution 5: Use certified lifting gear and correct manual-handling technique for heavy parts.

TOOLS & MATERIALS:
- Tool 1: Standard mechanical hand tools & calibrated torque wrench
- Tool 2: LOTO padlocks and permit
- Tool 3: Laser/dial alignment kit (as applicable)
- Tool 4: Feeler gauges, dial indicator, seal/bearing pullers
- Tool 5: Correct spare parts and gaskets per the BOM
- Tool 6: Lifting gear and slings (certified)

STEP-BY-STEP PROCEDURE:
- Step 1 – Action: Stop pump, isolate electrically (LOTO) before any lube work
- Step 1 – Check: Isolation & LOTO verified
- Step 2 – Action: Check the oil sight-glass level sits at the middle mark
- Step 2 – Check: Parts match BOM / spec
- Step 3 – Action: Top-up with ISO VG 68 only – never mix grades
- Step 3 – Check: Torque / clearance to spec
- Step 4 – Action: Inspect the constant-level oiler bottle and refill
- Step 4 – Check: No leak / smooth operation
- Step 5 – Action: Record oil condition (colour/water) on the weekly lube route sheet
- Step 5 – Check: Record in equipment history

COMMON PROBLEMS & TROUBLESHOOTING:
- Symptom: Hexane leak observed at GA-1201A seal gland during operation | Likely Cause: API Plan 11 flush orifice RO-1201 partially plugged causing seal face overheating | Action: Replaced mechanical seal cartridge, cleaned flush orifice
- Symptom: GA-1201A tripped on VSHH-1201 high vibration 7.4 mm/s | Likely Cause: Angular misalignment 0.12 mm/100mm after foundation settlement | Action: Laser re-aligned pump/motor, re-shimmed motor feet
- Symptom: Bearing DE noisy with rising temperature TI-1201 trend | Likely Cause: Outer race spalling on DE bearing due to prolonged misalignment | Action: Renewed DE bearing 7310 BECBM, flushed housing, refilled ISO VG 68

KEY LEARNING POINTS:
- Point 1: Maintain oil bath at the centre of the sight glass with ISO VG 68. Both over-fill and under-fill overheat the bearing.
- Point 2: Respect the interlock SEQ-1201: PSLL-1201 trips at < 0.5 barg – never defeat it without a permit.
- Point 3: Always cross-check the Datasheet limits and P&ID TJC-LLD-PID-1201 before working on GA-1201A.
- Point 4: Record the work in the equipment history so the Knowledge Hub stays the single source of truth.
